ModMetaData.name: Name Colony At Start
ModMetaData.author: DanZinagri
ModMetaData.description: Adds a "Name colony" button to the starting-pawn screen so you can name your faction and first settlement before the game begins, instead of waiting for the naming prompt a few days in. Safe to add to or remove from an existing save: the names are applied once when a new game starts, and nothing is stored in the save.
